His kind smile does little to assuage the dread and hopelessness he brings. Once it was said he neglected his duties and relinquished his scythe of unbecoming, but few dare speak of it in only the quickest of whispers.

It is also said that anything negated thus by his aegis ceases to exist in any realm but his, and with it he scythes his way between the realms of reality and the fugue that is Limbo, his domain. He tends to abstain from the squabbles of mortals and the conspiring of divines lest it corrupt his purpose as the guardian of transition, but those wise in the ways of the gods still offer him prayer that they may grow unimpeded.

Only once has his manifestation been usurped, and Zeus long since paid for his transgression.
